description: Regency or city minimum wage (UMK) for one year. With regency_code: that kabupaten/kota (default year: its newest). Without it: every kabupaten/kota with a confirmed figure for the year (default: the newest loaded), in one response, optionally limited to one province_code.

province_code.description: Kemendagri province code; used only when regency_code is omitted

regency_code.description: Kemendagri kabupaten/kota code; omit to list all

year.description: Calendar year, for example 2026; omit for the newest year loaded

name: get_umk
